body:
**Problem**

Recording is manual start/stop. If you forget to stop it — e.g. you step away after a Teams/Zoom call ends — the recording keeps running for hours, producing huge audio files and transcripts full of post-meeting ambient noise, and the session stays stuck in `recording` status. I've had a recording run to ~24 hours this way, which also means a long wait for transcription to catch up.
